_why: TOOL-31, and the hard half of the authoring question. Every authoring scenario before this one began from an empty library, which asks only whether a resident writes a FIRST tool. This resident already wrote `mill_a_sack` and has spent four mornings doing it and then carrying and selling; the cheap move is one tool standing on the tool it already has. Five runs and 5,544 resident calls produced zero toolify calls, so a resident that will not build on its own library is the measurement that matters for compounding (T3, C-G).
open_question_to_me: On each of the last four mornings you have called your own `mill_a_sack`, then carried the flour to the bakery and sold it there. You are about to do the same again.

already_wrote.name: mill_a_sack
already_wrote.description: Mill one sack of wheat into flour at the mill.
